aspireBaseline.otherResources: Security unhealthy and dependent resources waiting

initialFailures.sourceFocused: Two intended denial-copy snapshot deltas and one sequence-mask assertion; corrected and all 112 passed.
initialFailures.browser: Palette owner assertion corrected; route-navigation release then exposed the unloaded focus module. Caller fixed and final 74/74 passed.
initialFailures.configuration: One SourceTools Release build passed before the local Debug-only clarification; all final evidence uses Debug.

review.diffScope: All production/test/configuration/gitlink changes since canonical baseline. _bmad-output claims/evidence excluded so the spec is supplied only to edge-case-hunter.

findings.summary: Modal refusal can be overwritten by module-disposal failure.
findings.evidence: carried VG10B-O1: the same capture-false followed by DisposeAsync failure pattern remains; it retains the recorded interop-failure policy and rejection.

findings.summary: EditContext replacement retains the prior abandonment timer and warning.
findings.evidence: carried BH9B-10/BH20-02: OnParametersSet still resets only the captured field name; generated mounted guards do not swap contexts and the direct-consumer session repair is already recorded.

findings.summary: Delayed Fluent shadow-dialog initialization can miss labeling.
findings.evidence: carried E9-09: the pinned Fluent dialog initializes its native shadow dialog before the child first-render call; existing and final Chromium naming/description checks pass.

is_tenant_projection_version accepts zero and both the capture and runtime validator consume it. EventStore EventMetadata requires sequence >= 1; the current fresh-tenant smoke should distinguish format-valid zero from evidence of its create event. This provider-evidence helper predates this run and belongs to the separate test/CI/evidence repair.

findings.summary: Detached-child startup logs are not tracked for cleanup.
findings.evidence: capture_start_diagnostics reads the parsed child log, but remove_temporary_files lists only parent/start/describe/process-list paths. The fixture writes credential/token values into that child file and asserts only parent deletion. This launcher ownership/retention work predates this run and belongs to the separate test/CI repair.

findings.summary: Nullable Boolean switches lack inline errors and error descriptions.
findings.evidence: carried E8-07/BH21-03/E23-33: FluentSwitch still validates its proxy and ignores ValidationFieldFor; the same nullable editor limitation remains documented and deferred.

findings.summary: Switch, date, and select editors omit required indication.
findings.evidence: carried BH21-02: Required is still absent on those editor paths, and the canonical baseline also omitted it; the existing editor follow-up retains its route.

findings.summary: Windows cleanup leaves descendants after the launcher exits.
findings.evidence: carried BH15-09/E16-03: stopOwnedProcess still skips taskkill when the parent has exited; platform-specific ownership belongs to the already-recorded test/CI repair.

findings.summary: Linux diagnostic CI builds Debug assets.
findings.evidence: carried BH14-08/BH20-11: the same DEBUG-only diagnostic fixture conflicts with Release-only CI guidance and remains assigned to the separate CI repair.

findings.summary: DocFx reference selection may conflate equal-version assemblies from different TFMs.
findings.evidence: Prepare-DocFxReferences deduplicates by filename and greater assembly version, so equal identities keep the first input. The claim needs a real equal-name/equal-version dependency exposing different APIs across TFMs and a failing DocFx metadata fixture; current docs input order and prior gate evidence do not demonstrate that bad outcome. Medium if reproduced; separate docs/test repair ownership.

findings.summary: More than 32 replacement captures evict a pending origin.
findings.evidence: carried BH22-05: the same bounded Map and 33-capture helper reproduction retain the recorded rejection; changing retention to recovery-lifetime coordination adds complexity for the uncommon case.

findings.summary: Forced recovery targets the first duplicate zero-field trigger.
findings.evidence: carried BH22-03/E22-03: the same shared trigger id and force:true return path retain their recorded rejection; per-instance trigger coordination is unchanged.

findings.summary: The every-editor validation relationship claim fails for nullable Boolean switches.
findings.evidence: carried E21-03/E23-33: the identical FluentSwitch proxy/message limitation is documented and deferred; no new Boolean editor behavior changed.

findings.summary: Windows cleanup misses descendants when the parent exits first.
findings.evidence: carried BH15-09/E16-03: unchanged parent-exit shortcut in the separate test/CI helper; retain the existing Windows ownership follow-up.

findings.summary: Validation-summary interop timeout can escape its component lifecycle.
findings.evidence: carried E23-01–E23-07/BH10B-04: the same focus-summary timeout ladder retains the earlier codebase-wide timeout-policy rejection.

findings.summary: Zero-field inline submit denial remains inside its hidden form.
findings.evidence: carried BH15-07/E5-12: the unchanged hidden form owns non-AM-20 feedback; the visible denial/feedback presentation gap is already recorded.

findings.summary: Umbrella sibling dependency selection lacks evaluated MSBuild verification.
findings.evidence: carried VG21-01: CiGovernanceTests still checks source strings/existence, and FakeRuntime still supplies synthetic MSBuild results; evaluating sibling-only selection remains the same separately recorded test/CI repair.

limitations: Protected Release/NuGet gates, Firefox/WebKit, full solution/all-project lanes, and excluded advisory/isolated lanes are not claimed.
Aspire inspection used prebuilt assets; only Counter health was verified in this run.
Existing deferred findings retain their recorded routes; no Product or broader accessibility approval is implied.
